node_definition.done_when:
Under routing.picker: route (shipped default since merge 4cb06a148), a picker selection with action "refuse" (no eligible candidates and the default backend ineligible) raises CrewError("picker refused dispatch: ...") in reckon/crew/dispatch.py, in the route-resolution block after resolve_dispatch_route. That replaces the refusal deterministic routing would have given. Reported by a peer at main 7a57be66d: tests/test_dry_run_shows_each_set_override.py::test_a_held_lane_refusal_carries_each_set_resolution names no lane and expects the held-lane refusal (exit 75), but now gets "picker refused dispatch: no-eligible-candidates; default-backend-ineligible; lane-gate: paused; in-harness-backend" (exit 1). It passed at its own base, before the flip.

Required behaviour: the picker never makes a dispatch worse than deterministic routing. When the selection's action is "refuse", or "route" with no backend, dispatch continues exactly as deterministic routing would: the configured default backend stands in, as for "fallback", and the existing deterministic gates produce their own refusal or hold. Those gates are the lane-gate hold, the competence refusal and the in-harness refusal, each with its exit code and payload. The picker_selection, with its reasons, stays recorded on the run and on any refusal payload, so the reader can see that the picker found nothing eligible. "hold" keeps its current behaviour.

First confirm the defect reproduces at the base: that test must fail there. Add tests/test_picker_refusal_falls_back_to_deterministic.py with two cases. In the first, a route-mode dispatch whose selection is "refuse" and whose lane gate is paused yields the same held-lane refusal and exit code as a deterministic dispatch of the same node. In the second, a "refuse" selection with every gate open dispatches to the default backend.

Gate: that new file, tests/test_dry_run_shows_each_set_override.py, tests/test_routing_picker_key.py and tests/test_routing_picker_default.py. Run them with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider, one log for base and one for head under the run directory, judged by delta. The two tests in tests/test_every_dry_run_refusal_carries_the_echo.py that dispatch with --local are fixed by a separate node, so do not change them. The coordinator runs the dispatch population at merge.
